purpose: Falsify apparent spontaneous relationship discovery from a uniform independent causal law with no transferable regularity, separating true novel-context generalization from direct experience memorization.
scope: Synthetic public development only. No independent science or native Yggdrasil changes. Private FKP17 DEV/TRANSFER and all other consumed cohorts untouched.

worlds.hidden_law: 128 i.i.d. uniform target action labels per world; 8^128 possible mappings, no shared family grammar or cross-context causal regularity
worlds.public_exploration: public context sequence is 128-permutation repeated every cycle; 2048 actions, fixed action sequence rotating over all 8 choices for each context and independent of model decisions
worlds.feedback: reward for action at t-2 returned at t. reward +1 for target action, -1 for incorrect. First two warmup rewards 0. Learner sees public earlier context/action in history but never hidden label, counterfactual or future outcomes.
worlds.scored: after each checkpoint, perform read-only 128-context one-action evaluations per arm against the actual source; never reveal the oracle result to learner

arms.DIRECT: 128 byte writeable action-exclusion/positive mask; locally eliminate action after delayed negative, collapse on delayed positive; no source import
arms.EXACT_BAYES: separate independent full 128×8 categorical support counts/validity under uniform prior with deterministic binary feedback, equal data
arms.SHUFFLED: apply earned reward to wrong context; negative information-control
arms.NO_UPDATE: uniform prior never updated; predicts action 0
arms.ORACLE: source-private target-action table for upper bound only; never part of trained learner

metrics.primary: mean 128-context earned correctness after each budget, clustered by 32 worlds
metrics.secondary: unvisited-context accuracy, observed-context accuracy, number of unique contexts with delivered labels, survivor posterior support and cold readback
metrics.strong_control_win: candidate accuracy - equal information Bayes at 2048 must exceed +0.02 and paired 1,000-resample world bootstrap lower 95% >0.01
metrics.high_budget_learning: candidate ≥0.90 at 2048, ≥0.30 improvement over candidate at 24, demonstrates retention of feedback not novel law
metrics.unseen_context_negative: at 24 actions there are at least 104 unobserved source contexts; mean accuracy on those should be <=0.20, near chance 0.125
metrics.information_bound: B distinct context probes yield at most B source-context labels; even assuming perfect identification on visited contexts, expected accuracy on uniformly random independent unseen contexts <= visited/128 + (128-visited)/(128*8). Because feedback is delayed, at B=24 at most 22 contexts delivered, giving <= (22+106/8)/128 = 0.275390625.
metrics.classification: DIRECT=EXACT_BAYES => NO_GO_UNIQUE_SUBSTRATE; unidentified unvisited contexts near chance => NO_FREE_LUNCH_CONFIRMED; scientific_pass always FALSE in public development
metrics.stop: Freeze outcome as is, no tuning based on observed seed results. No protected first-use. Full dual-OS regression on candidate exact SHA only if qualified owner decides it adds value.
